approved_method_change.description: Approved same-run reference/current paired wall-clock gate replaces the current formal use of historical static absolute p95 values. It retains the v4 fixed relative allowances of 15.65%, 16.36%, and 15.64%; historical r1-r5 outcomes remain unchanged.
approved_method_change.protocol: Two independent temporary WSL trees use identical frozen fixtures, 1000 samples x 2 batches per scene, 10 warmups, balanced 50-sample AB/BA blocks, and hard wall-clock median and p95 gates. Thread/process CPU and cleanup are observation-only.

paired_recheck.reference_source_audit: 174 frozen ZIP members matched the fixed Git base/reviewed overlay and original fixtures byte-for-byte before current harness clock control was added; all archive members are ordinary 100644; ZIP unchanged; no content hashes used

observation.qualification: Both sides exactly matched unchanged behavior v2, used isolated module origins and equal environments, disabled env files, reported zero network/database access, and cleaned their temporary trees. This is not formal performance acceptance.

clock_control.finding: Two legacy behavior tests failed after the host date changed to 2026-10-24: import-time prompt and nested policy route defaults leaked the original capture date. Explicit input patches reproduce unchanged behavior v2; no date, plan ID or business output fields are normalized away.
clock_control.scope: Shared current harness control, not a production clock change or rewrite of the frozen ZIP.

post_full_gate_cli_validation.reason: Moved the new clock-helper import below existing project sys.path setup; no business or timing logic changed after the full gate.
post_full_gate_cli_validation.isolated_cli_help: python -I scripts/modularization_baseline.py --help with PYTHONPATH removed; a regression test also runs from an external temporary cwd

paired_recheck.independent_review: Both reports were recomputed from raw wall samples using integer median/nearest-rank p95 and exact rational fixed allowances. 24000 total measured wall samples; 120 AB/BA blocks per run; behavior v2 unchanged; temporary trees removed. This proves only the approved offline regression gate, not a production SLO or resolution of all scheduling noise.

formal_plan.policy: Run A and B independently and serially; both must pass; retain any failure and do not append retries merely to obtain a pass.

current_recheck.summary: All three predeclared r5 formal comparisons exited 1 while behavior comparison passed. loop_success.p95_ns exceeded its unchanged frozen limit in every run; knowledge_retrieval_success.p95_ns also exceeded its unchanged frozen limit in run 1. ready_success passed in all three runs.

default_compare.failure: ready_success.p95_ns exceeded the frozen 15.65% relative allowance plus observed spread
default_compare.other_scenarios: All loop and knowledge median/p95 measurements passed.
default_compare.stability_note: Scenario medians and non-timed cleanup medians were broadly higher than the candidate, but no specific cause is proven; read-only process and listener checks found no residual Python, Node, Playwright, or port 8899 listener.

diagnostic_note: An initial diagnostic that retained capture results is not formal evidence. The reviewed paired diagnostic supported controlling GC initial conditions before each fixture sample; it does not establish a production speedup.

r3_default_compare.status: failed; ready_success.p95_ns exceeded the frozen limit by 15208 ns

v2_formal_default_compare.reason: ready_success.p95_ns exceeded the frozen fixed relative allowance

performance_candidate.validation_policy: Both independent validations passed using the fixed candidate relative allowances without relaxation.

protocol.comparability: Schema 1.3 proxy- and GC-controlled measurements are not directly comparable with earlier protocols.
